definitions.loading: Initial-geometry full-wrench affine Gibbs buckling Q=K-tH+t*p0*V*D2, internal plus three symmetric cell strains
definitions.solver: Elastic congruence u=w-Kff^-1 B epsilon; full coupled generalized eigenproblem, no inversion at critical tangent
definitions.cell_participation: K-orthogonal relaxed homogeneous elastic energy / total elastic energy, between 0 and 1; not raw coordinate norm
definitions.scope: Periodic supercell Gamma internal and homogeneous cell strains; no full supercell Bloch search
definitions.cluster_boundary_comparison: Open-boundary and torus cluster fractions use the fixed-cell critical-mode elastic tile energies
definitions.long_endpoints: fixed-cell modes at 3000 and 30000 sweeps; arbitrary solver mode within any unresolved degeneracy
